questions.q: Find the sum of the first $20$ terms of the arithmetic sequence with $a=3$, $d=4$, using $S_n=\frac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d)$.
Find the sum of the first $15$ terms of the arithmetic sequence with $a=50$, $d=-3$.
Find the sum of the arithmetic series $2+5+8+\cdots+50$.
Find the sum of the first $10$ positive multiples of $6$.
questions.answer: These form an arithmetic sequence with $a=6$, $d=6$, $n=10$. $S_{10}=\frac{10}{2}(12+9(6))=5(12+54)=5(66)=330$.
questions.explanation: These form an arithmetic sequence with $a=6$, $d=6$, $n=10$. $S_{10}=\frac{10}{2}(12+9(6))=5(12+54)=5(66)=330$.
